commit.message:
SfM: Update visibility on feature transitions (CPU perf) (#5006)

## Summary

Update the visibility pyramid only when an image feature gains its first
triangulated correspondence or loses its last. Extra supporting
correspondences leave occupied cells unchanged, so repeating every
pyramid-level update does unnecessary work.

This is a small inherited optimization, based directly on official
COLMAP 3c1a1b957cc96d88849e4d30e1d0ec51c9da501b.

## Changes

- Move SetPoint/ResetPoint into the existing zero/one visibility
transitions.
- Extend the maintained score test with repeated support, distinct
colliding features, partial/final removal and underflow checks.
- Extend AddImage with observation removal and reconstruction of the
manager, avoiding unrelated fork registration behavior.

## Background

The update pattern dates to fe8f82aee9829c6c828158da2695e2d87a977f74,
"Initial commit" (2016), in src/base/image.cc. It was retained by
eaebe3c34b535e38d9101a5eba81cde994b9b279, "Add ObservationManager
(#2575)".

## Results

The source-equivalent transition change was measured in a composed-fork
fixed bookkeeping probe: Add64/Delete32/Delete32 on 16 images, 64 tracks
and 120 pairs.

| Platform | Before | After |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Linux/WSL | 1.395 ms | 0.640 ms |
| Windows | 2.776 ms | 1.438 ms |

Each table value is the arithmetic mean of four fresh process means per
arm (ABBAABBA). Each process mean averages ten measured batches after
two warmups. Canonical inputs and outputs agree within each platform.
These are fixed bookkeeping timings, not reconstruction throughput
measurements.

## Validation

- Independent source review accepted the clean-base production change
and adapted lifecycle fixture.
- Clean base and candidate each passed all 15 maintained manager cases,
without skips.
- Configured clang-tidy-18 checked observation_manager.cc in both arms
and the maintained test with no displayed source diagnostics;
generated/header warnings were suppressed.
- Reused retained pristine-upstream support and rebuilt the two selected
consumers of newer RANSAC headers; final source, link and provider
checks passed.
- Separately, the composed-fork version passed 18 manager and two mapper
cases on Linux and Windows.
